trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all production regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release from the deployment history.
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0002) describing the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the first incident-creation attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid creating a duplicate.
